opening.argument: The presentation promotes earning Bitcoin through BitConnect while pairing that invitation with a millionaire-level wealth claim. Its title states, “PROOF that 1 Bitcoin Make You A Millionaire,” and the speaker claims, “I simply interact with the BitConnect blockchain and get paid for that.” He then directs viewers to participate through his referral link, explicitly saying, “join BitConnect using my referral link.” The video also supplies a concrete signup path: the on-screen instructions identify a website, describe signup as free, request an email for step-by-step contact, and offer $100 after signup. Together, these elements present a low-barrier route to acquire a reward or asset, supported by a wealth claim and a direct referral invitation.
